title: Security page
summary: The site's Security page lists the controls that protect code, secrets and teams today, who processes data, and the plan toward SOC 2.
usage: Open the Security page from the site footer or Ctrl+K › Security. Each control links to its page in this manual: local projects, secret redaction, sensitive files, command and LLM policies, the validation policy, member access, the audit log, two-step verification, row-level security in the database and opt-in telemetry. The compliance plan says what is in progress (inventory of systems and data, written policies) and what comes next; JayV is not SOC 2 certified yet.
